evidence.note: Authentication record declares only an Aad block (AuthorizationUri, Resource, Scope). No anonymous, key, username-password, windows, or oauth kind is declared.
REST calls to the Power BI / Fabric APIs go through Web.Contents (line 303), reached from Web.JsonContents (317-344).
Data is read through Sql.Database (line 335) inside Extension.InvokeWithCredentials.

The only shared-function parameter is optional options, typed as FabricSqlOptions. No server, resource-id, or region parameter exists; the workspace and SQL IDs come from navigation, not from parameters.

options-fields.text: The declared FabricSqlOptions type accepts only HierarchicalNavigation (logical). GetFabricSqlDetails forwards CommandTimeout, CreateNavigationProperties, HierarchicalNavigation and EnableBulkInsert from options to Sql.Database.

evidence.note: FabricSqlOptions declares optional HierarchicalNavigation only.
Record.SelectFields passes CommandTimeout, CreateNavigationProperties, HierarchicalNavigation, EnableBulkInsert to Sql.Database.
Response bodies from the REST API are parsed with Json.Document. These payloads (workspace, item and SQL endpoint lists) build the returned navigation tables.
Table data is returned as driver rows from Sql.Database.
Table.FromRecords sets column names (id, displayName) from record fields with no M types assigned.
Table.FromRecords sets column names only, with no declared M types.
Sql.Database supplies the names and types of the returned SQL tables, and the connector does not redefine them.
ManualStatusHandling is set on every call (line 296). Status is read from Value.Metadata (line 304) and routed through handlers (lines 305-309), so status handling is not left to Power Query.
Error.Record values are built from the HTTP error body and status (lines 363-375, 386-396).
Error.Record is built for request failures, including the HTTP status code.
Documentation.Name, Caption, Description and LongDescription are set on the function type.
HierarchicalNavigationOptionType sets Documentation.FieldCaption.
Items are listed at runtime from the v1/workspaces/.../items?type=SQLDatabase endpoint.
Workspaces are listed at runtime from /v1/workspaces.
Workspace rows are folders (IsLeaf = false) that open further navigation tables.
Database rows are non-leaf (IsLeaf = false) and their Data opens SQL schema and table navigation.

TestConnection returns the name "FabricSql.Contents", the shared entry function. Workspace.pqm's OnTestConnection path (line 71) is not wired, because FabricSqlImpl calls GetWorkspacesNavTable with no test function.
A Table.View is built with OnSelectRows (line 277) and GetExpression (line 278). It is reached from GetTables and FilterSchemas.
The navigation Table.View implements OnSelectRows (line 60), a folding handler on navigation tables.
Sql.Database folds on its own, with cross-database folding disabled.
OnSelectRows handler.
GetExpression handler.
other: OnInvoke answers Value.Versions and Value.VersionIdentity. It has no listed id.
Code is loaded from .pqm files through Extension.Contents and Expression.Evaluate.
Utils, Workspace, FabricEnvironment and other modules are loaded from .pqm files.
Extension.LoadString supplies localized resource strings.
Icon images are loaded with Extension.Contents.
Beta = true.
Diagnostics.Trace at Error level runs with no switch.
Diagnostics.Trace at Warning level runs on live HTTP error responses with no switch.
Diagnostics.Trace runs on the missing-properties path with no switch.
